dialogues.jp: 俺は、環の病室の前で立っている。
dialogues.en: I stood in front of the hospital where Tamaki was staying.
dialogues.text: I stood in front of the hospital where Tamaki was staying.

dialogues.jp:
救急車で運ばれた環は、その日、そのまま意識
は回復しなかった。
dialogues.en:
Since the day she was rushed here by the ambulance, she
hadn't opened her eyes.
dialogues.text:
Since the day she was rushed here by the ambulance, she
hadn't opened her eyes.

dialogues.jp:
昨日、見舞いに来たときは、学校帰りに寄った
ため、面会時間は過ぎていて、会えなかった
のだ。
dialogues.en:
I wanted to visit her yesterday, but school events prevented
me from doing so.
dialogues.text:
I wanted to visit her yesterday, but school events prevented
me from doing so.

dialogues.jp: で、今日。
dialogues.en: So it had to wait for today.
dialogues.text: So it had to wait for today.

dialogues.jp: 俺は私用があるからと言って、学校を休んだ。
dialogues.en: A day where I had free time, a rest day from school.
dialogues.text: A day where I had free time, a rest day from school.

dialogues.jp:
環に一目会いたくて、花屋でアイリスの花束を
買い、病室を訪れる。
dialogues.en: I'd bought a bouquet of irises for her as well.
dialogues.text: I'd bought a bouquet of irises for her as well.

dialogues.jp:
俺はドアの前で深く息を吸い込み、吐き出す。
そして、意を決してノックする。
dialogues.en:
I stood outside her room door, and took a deep breath,
before knocking and entering.
dialogues.text:
I stood outside her room door, and took a deep breath,
before knocking and entering.

dialogues.jp: すると、中から、環のお父さんが顔を出す。
dialogues.en: Unexpectedly, her father was already inside.
dialogues.text: Unexpectedly, her father was already inside.

dialogues.jp: 「どうも……お見舞いに来ました」
dialogues.en: "Excuse me... I came to visit."
dialogues.text: "Excuse me... I came to visit."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki's Father
dialogues.jp: 「やあ、朝倉くん」
dialogues.en: "Hello, Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "Hello, Asakura-kun."

dialogues.jp:
お父さんは、少し疲れた顔で、にっこりと笑っ
た。
dialogues.en: He had a tired look on his face, but still gave me a smile.
dialogues.text: He had a tired look on his face, but still gave me a smile.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki's Father
dialogues.jp:
「すまないね。ちょうど私が出ていたばかりに
　君に迷惑をかけてしまった。あらためてお礼
　を言うよ。環を助けてくれて、ありがとう」
dialogues.en:
"I must thank you. You've done so much for Tamaki... even
saved her life, when I was out."
dialogues.text:
"I must thank you. You've done so much for Tamaki... even
saved her life, when I was out."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki's Father
dialogues.jp:
「いえ、……俺の方こそ、環が学校に来ないの
　で行ってみたら、倒れてて」
dialogues.en:
"It was nothing... I just had a bad feeling when I found out
that she didn't come to school..."
dialogues.text:
"It was nothing... I just had a bad feeling when I found out
that she didn't come to school..."

dialogues.jp:
あの時、背筋に走った氷のような悪寒を思い出
す。
dialogues.en:
The chills that ran down my spine when I saw her fallen
figure was still fresh in my memory.
dialogues.text:
The chills that ran down my spine when I saw her fallen
figure was still fresh in my memory.

dialogues.jp: 「それで……、環の容態は？」
dialogues.en: "Um... how's Tamaki doing?"
dialogues.text: "Um... how's Tamaki doing?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki's Father
dialogues.jp:
「それがね……、実はあれから環は目を覚まし
　ていないんだ」
dialogues.en: "Well... she still has not woken up."
dialogues.text: "Well... she still has not woken up."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki's Father
dialogues.jp:
「医者の話では、どこも悪いところはないらし
　い。どうして、意識が戻らないのか、原因は
　不明だそうだ」
dialogues.en:
"The doctor said her life wasn't in danger, but they can't
figure out why she hasn't regained consciousness."
dialogues.text:
"The doctor said her life wasn't in danger, but they can't
figure out why she hasn't regained consciousness."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki's Father
dialogues.jp: 「そんな……」
dialogues.en: "No way..."
dialogues.text: "No way..."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、奥のベッドに寝ている環に目をやる。
dialogues.en: I turned my gaze to Tamaki, laying on the hospital bed.
dialogues.text: I turned my gaze to Tamaki, laying on the hospital bed.

dialogues.jp:
そこには、まるで人形であるかのように静かに
横たわる環の姿があった。
dialogues.en: Her figure was so silent and still, she looked like a doll.
dialogues.text: Her figure was so silent and still, she looked like a doll.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki's Father
dialogues.jp:
「もちろん、若干の疲労などは見られるらしい
　が、どれも昏睡するような理由ではないそう
　だ」
dialogues.en:
"She has been overexerting herself lately, but that doesn't
explain this deep sleep..."
dialogues.text:
"She has been overexerting herself lately, but that doesn't
explain this deep sleep..."

dialogues.jp:
お父さんは、力無く椅子に腰をおろし、眉間を
きゅうっと押さえる。
dialogues.en:
The father leaned back in his chair further, rubbing his
forehead.
dialogues.text:
The father leaned back in his chair further, rubbing his
forehead.

dialogues.jp: 「そうですか……」
dialogues.en: "I see..."
dialogues.text: "I see..."

dialogues.jp:
お父さんの姿を見ても、俺はそんな言葉しか口
にすることができなかった。
dialogues.en: He looked so tired, I didn't know what else to say.
dialogues.text: He looked so tired, I didn't know what else to say.

dialogues.jp:
俺はなんて無力なんだろう……。環にも、お父
さんにも、何をしてあげることはできないのだ
ろうか。
dialogues.en:
I feel so useless... I can't do anything for Tamaki, or even
her father.
dialogues.text:
I feel so useless... I can't do anything for Tamaki, or even
her father.

dialogues.jp: どこも悪くないのに、意識不明……。
dialogues.en: Unconscious, yet normal otherwise...
dialogues.text: Unconscious, yet normal otherwise...

dialogues.jp: 一体、環の身に何があったんだ……？
dialogues.en: What on earth's wrong with her body...?
dialogues.text: What on earth's wrong with her body...?

dialogues.jp:
環の顔を見つめているが、もちろん、何も答え
てはくれない。
dialogues.en:
I stared at her as I questioned myself, but of course, she
wasn't going to answer.
dialogues.text:
I stared at her as I questioned myself, but of course, she
wasn't going to answer.

dialogues.jp:
もし、環の身体が何とも無いなら、環の心で何
か負荷がかかっているのかもしれない。
dialogues.en:
If there's nothing wrong with her physical self... maybe
it's her mental self that's the problem.
dialogues.text:
If there's nothing wrong with her physical self... maybe
it's her mental self that's the problem.

dialogues.jp:
だとしたら、いったい何が環を苦しめているん
だ……。
dialogues.en: Something that's troubled her this badly...
dialogues.text: Something that's troubled her this badly...

dialogues.jp: 「環……、いったい、どうしちゃったんだよ」
dialogues.en: "Tamaki... what's happened to you."
dialogues.text: "Tamaki... what's happened to you."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、眠っている環に話しかける。
dialogues.en: I started talking to the asleep Tamaki.
dialogues.text: I started talking to the asleep Tamaki.

dialogues.jp:
環は、まるで死んでいるかのように、ベッドに
寝ていた。
dialogues.en: She continued lying there, dead to the world.
dialogues.text: She continued lying there, dead to the world.

dialogues.jp:
「俺は……お前を助けてやれないのか？　なあ、
　環……目を覚ましてくれよ」
dialogues.en:
"Isn't there... anything I can do to help you? C'mon,
Tamaki... wake up..."
dialogues.text:
"Isn't there... anything I can do to help you? C'mon,
Tamaki... wake up..."

dialogues.jp:
その白い頬をそっと撫でる。やわらかさとほん
のりとした温かさが手の平に伝わってくる。
dialogues.en:
I gently caressed her fair cheeks, so soft and warm on the
palm of my hand.
dialogues.text:
I gently caressed her fair cheeks, so soft and warm on the
palm of my hand.

dialogues.jp: 死んでなどいない。環はここに生きているのだ。
dialogues.en: She's not dead. She's still alive, somehow.
dialogues.text: She's not dead. She's still alive, somehow.

dialogues.en: "Tamaki... Tamaki..."
dialogues.text: "Tamaki... Tamaki..."

dialogues.jp: ぎゅっと環の手を握る。
dialogues.en: I took her hand in mine.
dialogues.text: I took her hand in mine.

dialogues.jp: 力無い環の手……。
dialogues.en: Unmoving and limp...
dialogues.text: Unmoving and limp...

dialogues.jp: 「環……目を覚ましてくれ……」
dialogues.en: "Tamaki... please, wake up..."
dialogues.text: "Tamaki... please, wake up..."

dialogues.jp: 握る手に力が入る。
dialogues.en: My grip on her head steadily grew stronger.
dialogues.text: My grip on her head steadily grew stronger.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki's Father
dialogues.jp: 「──朝倉くん」
dialogues.en: "--Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "--Asakura-kun."

dialogues.jp: ポンと俺の肩に手が置かれる。
dialogues.en: I suddenly felt a hand on my shoulder.
dialogues.text: I suddenly felt a hand on my shoulder.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki's Father
dialogues.jp:
「大丈夫だよ、環はきっと目を覚ますよ。環だっ
　ていつまでも君を悲しませたくはないと思っ
　ているさ」
dialogues.en:
"It will be fine, she will wake up. The last thing she would
want is to make you feel sad."
dialogues.text:
"It will be fine, she will wake up. The last thing she would
want is to make you feel sad."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki's Father
dialogues.jp: 「けれど……」

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki's Father
dialogues.jp: 「きっと、環は迷っているだけさ」
dialogues.en: "I'm sure she's just lost her way."
dialogues.text: "I'm sure she's just lost her way."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki's Father
dialogues.jp: 「迷って……いる？」
dialogues.en: "Lost... her way?"
dialogues.text: "Lost... her way?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki's Father
dialogues.jp:
「ああ。でも、いつか気づくはずだよ。君と環
　は深い絆で結ばれているんだろう？　迷うこ
　となんてないんだってね」
dialogues.en:
"Yes, but she'd certainly notice it... the deep bond you and
her share. She'd find her way through that."
dialogues.text:
"Yes, but she'd certainly notice it... the deep bond you and
her share. She'd find her way through that."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki's Father
dialogues.jp: 「深い絆……」
dialogues.en: The deep bond..."
dialogues.text: The deep bond..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki's Father
dialogues.jp:
「妻がよく言っていたよ。朝倉くんと環は深い
　絆で結ばれているってね」
dialogues.en:
"My wife would often talk about that, about how you and
Tamaki were tied together by a deep bond."
dialogues.text:
"My wife would often talk about that, about how you and
Tamaki were tied together by a deep bond."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki's Father
dialogues.jp:
「アレは、昔から不思議な力があったから、何
　か見えていたのかもしれない」
dialogues.en:
"She used to have strange powers back in the days, she
might've possibly seen something."
dialogues.text:
"She used to have strange powers back in the days, she
might've possibly seen something."

dialogues.jp:
お父さんが、静かに頷きながら、俺に微笑みか
ける。
dialogues.en: He lightly nodded his head, giving me a gentle smile.
dialogues.text: He lightly nodded his head, giving me a gentle smile.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki's Father
dialogues.jp:
「今は、つらいかも知れないけれど……、元気
　を出しなさい」
dialogues.en: "I know it must be hard now... but try to smile through it."
dialogues.text: "I know it must be hard now... but try to smile through it."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、環のお父さんに優しく肩を抱かれながら、
その日は病室を後にした。
dialogues.en:
I lightly patted him on the shoulder, and left the hospital
for the day.
dialogues.text:
I lightly patted him on the shoulder, and left the hospital
for the day.

dialogues.jp: どうしたらいい？
dialogues.en: What should I do?
dialogues.text: What should I do?

dialogues.jp: どうしたら環は元気になる？
dialogues.en: What can I do, to make Tamaki happy again?
dialogues.text: What can I do, to make Tamaki happy again?

dialogues.jp:
もし、環が心で何かを迷っているのだとしたら、
何か苦しんでいるのだとしたら。
dialogues.en:
If it's true that Tamaki's soul has lost her way, and is in
deep pain now...
dialogues.text:
If it's true that Tamaki's soul has lost her way, and is in
deep pain now...

dialogues.jp:
俺はどうやって、環を助けてやることができる
のだろうか？
dialogues.en: What can I do to save her from that?
dialogues.text: What can I do to save her from that?

dialogues.jp: しかし、頭の中で。
dialogues.en: I wondered about that all day.
dialogues.text: I wondered about that all day.

dialogues.jp: 考えても考えても、悩んでも悩んでも。
dialogues.en: Thinking, pondering, beating myself up.
dialogues.text: Thinking, pondering, beating myself up.

dialogues.jp:
眠ったままの環のことを考えると、俺の方まで
苦しくて、切ない気持ちになってしまう。
dialogues.en:
The more I thought about the unconscious Tamaki, the more
painful it got for me.
dialogues.text:
The more I thought about the unconscious Tamaki, the more
painful it got for me.

dialogues.jp:
もし、環があのまま目が覚めなかったら、どこ
かへ行ってしまったら。
dialogues.en: If Tamaki stays like that forever, what'd happen to her...
dialogues.text: If Tamaki stays like that forever, what'd happen to her...

dialogues.jp: 俺は、どうなるんだろう？
dialogues.en: And what would I do?
dialogues.text: And what would I do?

dialogues.jp:
環がいなくなるなんて、今まで考えたこと無かっ
た。
dialogues.en:
I'd never thought about what'd happen to me if Tamaki's no
longer around.
dialogues.text:
I'd never thought about what'd happen to me if Tamaki's no
longer around.

dialogues.jp: そう考えていたら、急に自然と涙が溢れてくる。
dialogues.en:
So it surprised even me, when tears started to form in my
eyes when I thought about it.
dialogues.text:
So it surprised even me, when tears started to form in my
eyes when I thought about it.

dialogues.jp: 怖い……。
dialogues.en: It'd be horrible...
dialogues.text: It'd be horrible...

dialogues.jp:
大切な人が、ある日突然、日常から消えてしま
うこと……。
dialogues.en: The one you love, suddenly disappearing one day...
dialogues.text: The one you love, suddenly disappearing one day...

dialogues.jp: ダメだ。弱気になるな。
dialogues.en: No, no... I can't be weak.
dialogues.text: No, no... I can't be weak.

dialogues.jp: どうすれば、環を助けられる。
dialogues.en: What can I do to save her, that's what I need to find out.
dialogues.text: What can I do to save her, that's what I need to find out.

dialogues.jp:
環が、お父さんの言うとおり、迷うあまり現実
から目を背けているのだとしたら。
dialogues.en:
It's likely as her father said... she must be lost in
reality, thus wants to escape it.
dialogues.text:
It's likely as her father said... she must be lost in
reality, thus wants to escape it.

dialogues.jp: 彼女の夢の世界へ入れたら。
dialogues.en: By traveling and staying at the world of dreams.
dialogues.text: By traveling and staying at the world of dreams.

dialogues.jp: でも、そんなことできる訳がない……。
dialogues.en: But if that's the case, I can't do much about it...
dialogues.text: But if that's the case, I can't do much about it...

dialogues.jp:
最近は、なぜか、人の夢を見ることもなくなっ
ている。
dialogues.en:
For some reason, I've not seen anybody's dream recently
either.
dialogues.text:
For some reason, I've not seen anybody's dream recently
either.

dialogues.jp:
そんな中、都合良く、環の夢をみることなんて
できる訳がない。
dialogues.en: I'm not anything special, I can't just force it to happen.
dialogues.text: I'm not anything special, I can't just force it to happen.

dialogues.jp:
もっとも、それが解決方法になるかと言われれ
ば、そういう訳ではないのだろうけれど……。
dialogues.en:
If there's a way to resolve it, I won't be able to do it by
myself...
dialogues.text:
If there's a way to resolve it, I won't be able to do it by
myself...

dialogues.jp: こんな話、誰にも相談できやしない。
dialogues.en: I need to consult someone on this.
dialogues.text: I need to consult someone on this.

dialogues.jp: どうすればいいんだ……。
dialogues.en: What to do...
dialogues.text: What to do...

dialogues.jp: 一人で悩んでいたって、環は目を覚まさない。
dialogues.en: If I try to rely on myself only, Tamaki won't ever wake up.
dialogues.text: If I try to rely on myself only, Tamaki won't ever wake up.

dialogues.jp: 誰か……。
dialogues.en: But who...
dialogues.text: But who...

dialogues.jp:
そのとき、俺はふと、枯れない桜の木に抱きつ
いていたさくらのことが、頭をよぎる。
dialogues.en:
The image then came to me, the day Sakura brought me to the
Unwithering Sakura tree.
dialogues.text:
The image then came to me, the day Sakura brought me to the
Unwithering Sakura tree.

dialogues.jp:
そうだ、さくらになら……、あいつなら、俺の
話を聞いてくれる。
dialogues.en: That's right, Sakura... she'd listen to me.
dialogues.text: That's right, Sakura... she'd listen to me.

dialogues.jp: あいつなら、きっといい知恵を貸してくれる。
dialogues.en: I'm sure she'd have some idea of what to do.
dialogues.text: I'm sure she'd have some idea of what to do.

dialogues.jp: 俺は立ち上がり、さくらの家へと向かった。
dialogues.en: I got up, and headed for Sakura's house.
dialogues.text: I got up, and headed for Sakura's house.

dialogues.jp: 「さくら！！」
dialogues.en: "Sakura!!"
dialogues.text: "Sakura!!"

dialogues.jp: 俺はさくらの家へと駆け込む。
dialogues.en: I dashed towards her house.
dialogues.text: I dashed towards her house.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「はにゃ？　どうしたの？」
dialogues.en: "Hanyah? What's up?"
dialogues.text: "Hanyah? What's up?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「お前に、話がある！」
dialogues.en: "I need to talk to you!"
dialogues.text: "I need to talk to you!"

dialogues.jp:
きょとんとした目で、俺を見つめる。せんべい
を、ぼりんとかじりながら。
dialogues.en: She looked at me curiously, biting on a rice cracker.
dialogues.text: She looked at me curiously, biting on a rice cracker.

dialogues.jp: 「頼む！　俺には、もうお前しかいないんだ！」
dialogues.en: "Please! I need you with me!"
dialogues.text: "Please! I need you with me!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「はにゃ？」
dialogues.en: "Hanyah?"
dialogues.text: "Hanyah?"

dialogues.jp: さくらの顔が一瞬、色めき立つ。
dialogues.en: Sakura's face suddenly flushed red.
dialogues.text: Sakura's face suddenly flushed red.

dialogues.jp: 「あ、いや……そういう意味ではなく」
dialogues.en: "Ah, uh... I didn't mean it that way!"
dialogues.text: "Ah, uh... I didn't mean it that way!"

dialogues.jp: 俺はさくらに、環のことを一部始終、説明する。
dialogues.en:
After clearing up the misunderstanding, I told Sakura the
whole story.
dialogues.text:
After clearing up the misunderstanding, I told Sakura the
whole story.

dialogues.jp:
さくらとうたまるは、環の状況を説明する俺の
顔を、じっと見つめている。
dialogues.en:
Both her and Utamaru gave me their undivided attention as I
explained.
dialogues.text:
Both her and Utamaru gave me their undivided attention as I
explained.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……そっか」
dialogues.en: "...I see."
dialogues.text: "...I see."

dialogues.jp: さくらがぼそりと呟く。
dialogues.en: Sakura's voice then fell to a whisper.
dialogues.text: Sakura's voice then fell to a whisper.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そんなことになってたんだ……」
dialogues.en: "So that really happened..."
dialogues.text: "So that really happened..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「どうにかして、環のことを助けてやれないだ
　ろうか……」
dialogues.en: "I don't know if there's any way to save Tamaki..."
dialogues.text: "I don't know if there's any way to save Tamaki..."

dialogues.jp: さくらは黙ってしまう。
dialogues.en: Sakura turned silent for awhile.
dialogues.text: Sakura turned silent for awhile.

dialogues.jp: 「さくら？」
dialogues.en: "Sakura?"
dialogues.text: "Sakura?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……環ちゃんがね、病気になったのは」
dialogues.en: "...Tamaki-chan's sick right now."
dialogues.text: "...Tamaki-chan's sick right now."

dialogues.jp:
さくらが俺の方を、見据えて『巫女の力』と、
ぼそりと言った。
dialogues.en:
She looked at me, then started talking about the fabled Miko
powers.
dialogues.text:
She looked at me, then started talking about the fabled Miko
powers.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「今までは、環ちゃん、自分でコントロールで
　きていた部分もあるんだ」
dialogues.en: "Even now, Tamaki-chan's controlling and using her powers."
dialogues.text: "Even now, Tamaki-chan's controlling and using her powers."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「なるべく、悪い未来だけを見て、相手の危機
　を回避しようとしたり……。未来を読むのも
　選んでたんだろうけど……」
dialogues.en:
"They choose to see the future... knowing the responsibility
of keeping those in danger safe..."
dialogues.text:
"They choose to see the future... knowing the responsibility
of keeping those in danger safe..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なんのことだ……、さくら。何を言っている」
dialogues.en: "What the... what are you talking about, Sakura?"
dialogues.text: "What the... what are you talking about, Sakura?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「巫女の力が、それを助けてたんだ」
dialogues.en:
"That's what the power of Miko is used for; to save people
with bad futures."
dialogues.text:
"That's what the power of Miko is used for; to save people
with bad futures."

dialogues.jp: さくらは、キっと俺に目を向ける。
dialogues.en: Sakura then gazed sharply at me.
dialogues.text: Sakura then gazed sharply at me.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「でも、お兄ちゃんのせいだ」
dialogues.en: "But then, you messed it up."
dialogues.text: "But then, you messed it up."

dialogues.jp: まるで責めるような口調で、さくらは言う。
dialogues.en: She suddenly went from professor mode to critic mode.
dialogues.text: She suddenly went from professor mode to critic mode.

dialogues.jp: 「……なんだよ、俺のせいって」
dialogues.en: "...How did I mess it up?"
dialogues.text: "...How did I mess it up?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「環ちゃんが、お兄ちゃんに恋をしたから……。
　神にささげるための心を、お兄ちゃんに捧げ
　てしまった」
dialogues.en:
"Tamaki-chan fell in love with you... her heart, that was
supposed to belong to God, was yours instead."
dialogues.text:
"Tamaki-chan fell in love with you... her heart, that was
supposed to belong to God, was yours instead."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「だから、巫女としての力は、弱まってしまっ
　たんだよ」
dialogues.en: "That's why the powers bestowed on her as a Miko weakened."
dialogues.text: "That's why the powers bestowed on her as a Miko weakened."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「お兄ちゃんが、環ちゃんに恋なんかするから
　……」
dialogues.en: "Because you fell in love with her..."
dialogues.text: "Because you fell in love with her..."

dialogues.jp: さくらの言葉に胸が痛む。
dialogues.en: Her words were like arrows through my heart.
dialogues.text: Her words were like arrows through my heart.

dialogues.jp: 今までは、巫女の力がすべてを受け止めていた。
dialogues.en: All this while, she'd been receiving the powers of the Miko.
dialogues.text: All this while, she'd been receiving the powers of the Miko.

dialogues.jp:
様々な人々の想いを、未来を見てしまっても、
巫女の力が環を助けていた。
dialogues.en: Using her powers to save and help people in need.
dialogues.text: Using her powers to save and help people in need.

dialogues.jp:
『神に仕えるものは、恋をしてはいけないので
　しょうか？』
dialogues.en:
"Those who dedicate themselves to God can't fall in love,
right?"
dialogues.text:
"Those who dedicate themselves to God can't fall in love,
right?"

dialogues.jp:
巫女は純潔でなくてはならない。巫女としての
性質が強ければ強いほど……そうでなくてはな
らない。
dialogues.en:
A Miko is nothing if not pure. They have to be strong of
mind and soul...
dialogues.text:
A Miko is nothing if not pure. They have to be strong of
mind and soul...

dialogues.jp:
少なくとも、自分の心に迷いなどあっては、他
人の想いを預かる巫女などとても務まらないだ
ろう。
dialogues.en:
If she loses her faith even a little, she wouldn't be fit to
fix others' emotions anymore.
dialogues.text:
If she loses her faith even a little, she wouldn't be fit to
fix others' emotions anymore.

dialogues.jp:
恋が、環を迷わせた。俺という存在が環を迷わ
せた。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki became confused due to love. Tamaki became confused,
because I existed.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki became confused due to love. Tamaki became confused,
because I existed.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、いつか見た夢を思い出す。
dialogues.en: My mind harked back to the dream I'd always see.
dialogues.text: My mind harked back to the dream I'd always see.

dialogues.jp: ばあちゃんが、環と俺の記憶を封印する夢。
dialogues.en:
The dream where grandma sealed the memories that Tamaki and
I had.
dialogues.text:
The dream where grandma sealed the memories that Tamaki and
I had.

dialogues.jp:
環の巫女の力を暴走させるわけにはいかないか
ら、と。
dialogues.en:
I never understood why till now; It was to keep her Miko
powers from going crazy.
dialogues.text:
I never understood why till now; It was to keep her Miko
powers from going crazy.

dialogues.jp:
幼い環が巫女として成熟するためには、自分の
立場を受け止める力を持たなければならなかっ
たのだろう。
dialogues.en: She was raised from young to receive those powers...
dialogues.text: She was raised from young to receive those powers...

dialogues.jp:
将来を約束している人という、逃げ道は純潔で
なくてはならない巫女にとっては、不安要素で
しかなかった、そういうことだろう。
dialogues.en:
Her future was laid out for her, a future of purity... which
she doesn't want now...
dialogues.text:
Her future was laid out for her, a future of purity... which
she doesn't want now...

dialogues.jp: 現に今、環は迷うことで苦しんでいる。
dialogues.en: That's why she's lost and in pain now.
dialogues.text: That's why she's lost and in pain now.

dialogues.jp:
でも、なぜ……それをわかった上で、環のお母
さんは、記憶を失った環に、俺のことを伝えて
いたのだろう……。
dialogues.en:
But, knowing that, why...? Why would Tamaki's mother, after
sealing Tamaki's memories, tell her about me?
dialogues.text:
But, knowing that, why...? Why would Tamaki's mother, after
sealing Tamaki's memories, tell her about me?

dialogues.jp:
「さくら……、恋をすることは、そんなにいけ
　ないことなのか？」
dialogues.en: "Sakura... she can't fall in love at all?"
dialogues.text: "Sakura... she can't fall in love at all?"

dialogues.jp: さくらは、黙る。
dialogues.en: Sakura stayed silent.
dialogues.text: Sakura stayed silent.

dialogues.jp:
「一緒に過ごしたい、楽しみも苦しみも分かち
　合いたい、そう思うことはいけないことか？」
dialogues.en:
"Someone to spend your life with, through good times and
bad... they can't even think of that?"
dialogues.text:
"Someone to spend your life with, through good times and
bad... they can't even think of that?"

dialogues.jp:
「俺は、自分の大切な人を守りたい、苦しみか
　ら助けたい」
dialogues.en:
"...I want to protect the person most dear to me, I want to
ease her pain."
dialogues.text:
"...I want to protect the person most dear to me, I want to
ease her pain."

dialogues.jp: 「どうすればいい、さくら！　教えてくれ！」
dialogues.en: "So please! Tell me what to do, Sakura!"
dialogues.text: "So please! Tell me what to do, Sakura!"

dialogues.jp: 俺はひとり、叫ぶように言う。
dialogues.en: My speech changed to a plead.
dialogues.text: My speech changed to a plead.

dialogues.jp: 俺は絶対、環を……。
dialogues.en: No matter what, for Tamaki...
dialogues.text: No matter what, for Tamaki...

dialogues.jp: つい、声を荒げてしまった。
dialogues.en: I unintentionally raised my voice at her.
dialogues.text: I unintentionally raised my voice at her.

dialogues.jp: 環を助けたいばかりに……。
dialogues.en: I wanted to save Tamaki so much, but...
dialogues.text: I wanted to save Tamaki so much, but...

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……うらやましいよね」
dialogues.en: "...I'm so jealous."
dialogues.text: "...I'm so jealous."

dialogues.jp: さくらは上目遣いでぼそりと、口にした。
dialogues.en: Sakura glanced upwards at me as she spoke.
dialogues.text: Sakura glanced upwards at me as she spoke.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そんなに、守りたい人なんてさ」
dialogues.en: "To have someone who wants to protect her so much..."
dialogues.text: "To have someone who wants to protect her so much..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ずるいよ……環ちゃん」
dialogues.en: "That's not fair... Tamaki-chan."
dialogues.text: "That's not fair... Tamaki-chan."

dialogues.jp: さくらは俯いている。
dialogues.en: Her head fell in silence again.
dialogues.text: Her head fell in silence again.

dialogues.jp: 「……さくら」
dialogues.en: "...Sakura."
dialogues.text: "...Sakura."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、思わずさくらの肩に手を伸ばすが、さく
らはすっと立ち上がり、縁側に向かう。
dialogues.en:
I let go of her shoulders, which I'd unconsciously grabbed.
She stood up and gazed out the balcony.
dialogues.text:
I let go of her shoulders, which I'd unconsciously grabbed.
She stood up and gazed out the balcony.

dialogues.jp: そして、俺に背を向け、ポツリとつぶやいた。
dialogues.en: Then, with her back to me, she started murmuring.
dialogues.text: Then, with her back to me, she started murmuring.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ひとつだけ、方法がないこともないよ」
dialogues.en: "There's one method that could save her."
dialogues.text: "There's one method that could save her."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「本当か？」
dialogues.en: "Really?"
dialogues.text: "Really?"

dialogues.jp: さくらは振り向いてコックリ頷く。
dialogues.en: Sakura turned around to face me again, and nodded.
dialogues.text: Sakura turned around to face me again, and nodded.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ただし、すごく危険なんだ。失敗したら、も
　う二度と環ちゃんの意識は戻らないかもしれ
　ないけど……」
dialogues.en:
"But it's really dangerous. If it doesn't work, Tamaki-chan
might never wake up..."
dialogues.text:
"But it's really dangerous. If it doesn't work, Tamaki-chan
might never wake up..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「それに、お兄ちゃんだって、ただじゃすまな
　いかも」
dialogues.en: "And since it's you, it can't be done so easily..."
dialogues.text: "And since it's you, it can't be done so easily..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ボクとしては、お兄ちゃんがそんな危険な
　目にあうのは、あんまりオススメできない
　よ……」
dialogues.en: "I can't... easily recommend... putting you in such danger."
dialogues.text: "I can't... easily recommend... putting you in such danger."

dialogues.jp: さくらは戸惑うように言う。
dialogues.en: Sakura was steadily losing her comopsure.
dialogues.text: Sakura was steadily losing her comopsure.

dialogues.jp: 「でも、可能性はあるんだろ？」
dialogues.en: "But there's a chance, right?"
dialogues.text: "But there's a chance, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「だったら、頼む」
dialogues.en: "So, please..."
dialogues.text: "So, please..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「俺は、環を救ってやりたいんだ……」
dialogues.en: "I must save Tamaki..."
dialogues.text: "I must save Tamaki..."

dialogues.jp: 環のことを……。
dialogues.en: Tamaki...
dialogues.text: Tamaki...

dialogues.jp:
何者からも守ってやろうって、そう誓ったとき
から。
dialogues.en: I promised that I'd protect her, from whatever and whoever.
dialogues.text: I promised that I'd protect her, from whatever and whoever.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、どんなことがあっても、環を守る。
dialogues.en: And no matter what, I'd fulfill that promise.
dialogues.text: And no matter what, I'd fulfill that promise.

dialogues.jp: 「頼む、教えてくれ」
dialogues.en: "Please, tell me!"
dialogues.text: "Please, tell me!"

dialogues.jp: 失敗すれば、環は目覚めないかもしれない。
dialogues.en: If I fail, Tamaki might not ever wake up again.
dialogues.text: If I fail, Tamaki might not ever wake up again.

dialogues.jp:
でも、このまま何もせず、手をこまねいている
のは嫌だ。
dialogues.en: But I hate sitting here and not being able to do a thing.
dialogues.text: But I hate sitting here and not being able to do a thing.

dialogues.jp:
１００分の１でも可能性があるなら、それに賭
けたい。
dialogues.en: Even if it's a 1 out of 100 chance, I'd gamble on it.
dialogues.text: Even if it's a 1 out of 100 chance, I'd gamble on it.

dialogues.jp: 俺の命なんか、どうなったっていい。
dialogues.en: No matter what happens to me.
dialogues.text: No matter what happens to me.

dialogues.jp: さくらはまだ黙っている。
dialogues.en: Sakura stayed silent.
dialogues.text: Sakura stayed silent.

dialogues.jp: 「頼む、さくら……」
dialogues.en: "I beg you, Sakura..."
dialogues.text: "I beg you, Sakura..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "...Okay."
dialogues.text: "...Okay."

dialogues.jp: さくらは、重々しく口を開く。
dialogues.en: After a long while, she finally agreed.
dialogues.text: After a long while, she finally agreed.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「実はね……」
dialogues.en: "You have to..."
dialogues.text: "You have to..."

dialogues.jp: さくらはそっと、俺の耳に方法を打ち明けた。
dialogues.en: She then started to explain her plan, step by step.
dialogues.text: She then started to explain her plan, step by step.

dialogues.jp: ◆眠り続ける環◆
dialogues.en: ◆Sleeping Tamaki?◆
dialogues.text: ◆Sleeping Tamaki?◆

dialogues.jp: 環の見舞いに行くと、両親が付き添っていた。
dialogues.en: When I went to visit Tamaki, her father was there.
dialogues.text: When I went to visit Tamaki, her father was there.

dialogues.jp:
環は２日間意識が無いらしく、医者も原因がわ
からないという。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki had been unconscious for two days straight, and the
doctors couldn't answer why.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki had been unconscious for two days straight, and the
doctors couldn't answer why.

dialogues.jp:
さくらに相談すると、環が巫女の力を抑えきれ
なくなってしまったのだという。
dialogues.en:
When I consulted Sakura, she told me of how Tamaki had been
controlling her Miko powers.
dialogues.text:
When I consulted Sakura, she told me of how Tamaki had been
controlling her Miko powers.

dialogues.jp:
助け出す方法がひとつあるが、失敗したら環は
二度と目覚めないかもしれないと言う。
dialogues.en:
There was a way to save her, but failure would possibly
result in Tamaki never waking up again.
dialogues.text:
There was a way to save her, but failure would possibly
result in Tamaki never waking up again.

dialogues.jp:
でも、今よりはいい。俺はその方法にかけるこ
とにした。
dialogues.en: Despite that, I agreed.
dialogues.text: Despite that, I agreed.
